name: @pipeworx/mcp-nhl

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Check current NHL standings. Returns wins, losses, OT losses, points, goals for/against, and streak info for all teams.

tools.name: get_scores
tools.description: Get today's NHL game scores and status (live, final, or scheduled). Returns teams, scores, shots on goal, and current period.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Get the current NHL weekly schedule. Returns upcoming and recent games with teams, dates, times, and venues.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Get an NHL player's profile and current season stats by player ID. Returns bio, position, team, and season statistics.

playerId.description: NHL player ID (e.g., 8478402 for Connor McDavid)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nhl forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nhl pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
